result.summary: No single option can be put forward yet. The result is not yet robust — small changes could flip it. Olumi works out ‘Starter tier MRR’ as ‘Starter tier monthly price’ × ‘Starter subscribers’. That’s Olumi’s reading of how they combine; tell me if it’s wrong. 'Keep pricing as it is' was analysed as no change — the factors it compares against were held at the values your model records today. I supplied 6 of the values behind this, because your brief did not state them. They are mine rather than yours. Changing any of them changes what this model implies.
